title: Reduction of the actual unbounded integral exchange
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $A=\mathcal O_E$ and a uniformizer $\pi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $T$ put $R_T=p_T^*\underline{\mathcal O_E}=\varprojlim_{m\geq1}(A/\pi^m)_T$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients, det-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x-integral-limit], and $S_T=(A/\pi^n)_T$, the constant finite quotient ring sheaf, for a fixed $n\geq1$. Use the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D_R(T)=D(\operatorname{Mod}_{R_T})$, $D_S(T)=D(\operatorname{Mod}_{S_T})$ of internal module objects, the derived module pullback and pushforward with their derived adjunction [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], and the uncompleted relative derived tensor [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. Set $D_{n,T}K=K\otimes^L_{R_T}S_T$, the derived scalar extension of [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings].

Let $X'\xrightarrow{h}X$, $Y'\xrightarrow{g}Y$, $f:X\to Y$, $f':X'\to Y'$ form a chosen cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Write $L_{u,R},F_{u,R}$ and $L_{u,S},F_{u,S}$ for the geometric derived pullbacks and direct images on each edge $u$. Let $\operatorname{Ex}^R:L_{g,R}F_{f,R}\to F_{f',R}L_{h,R}$ and $\operatorname{Ex}^S:L_{g,S}F_{f,S}\to F_{f',S}L_{h,S}$ be the actual ambient exchanges [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange], defined by the unit, the canonical pullback-composition square, and the counit, including the module-object realization of those transformations. Use precisely the comparisons $\lambda_u$ and $\rho_{u,n}$ normalized in [lem-sfb-integral-quotient-direct-image-comparison].

For every $K\in D_R(X)$ the following equality holds in $D_S(Y')$:
$$F_{f',S}(\lambda_{h,K})\circ\operatorname{Ex}^S_{D_{n,X}K}\circ L_{g,S}(\rho_{f,n,K})
=\rho_{f',n,L_{h,R}K}\circ D_{n,Y'}(\operatorname{Ex}^R_K)\circ\lambda_{g,F_{f,R}K}.$$
Both sides have source $L_{g,S}D_{n,Y}F_{f,R}K$ and target $F_{f',S}D_{n,X'}L_{h,R}K$. In particular these specified isomorphisms identify the reduced actual integral exchange with the actual quotient-coefficient exchange. The equality is natural in $K$. No properness, completeness, boundedness, constructibility, or invertibility of the exchange is assumed. Under the internal-module/section-module equivalences, this equality is required to be the normalized finite-exchange rectangle [lem-weil-pbc-intrinsic-finite-exchange-rectangle], with its specified coefficient projection mates and pullback-composition comparisons; it is the identification with that independently specified ringed realization that is asserted as well.

proof.text: The published generic scalar_geometric_exchange_rectangle applies to the actual condensed reduction morphism and the supplied PullNormalized family b. Its scalarAmbientExchange is definitionally the ambient exchange here: both are mates under adj of the published geometric compositor square. Evaluating the whiskered natural transformations identifies the first asserted equality componentwise. The proved categorical route_natTrans_ext helper assembles component equality without unfolding the concrete derived-category functors.

The direct-image comparison supplies an invertible rho for a normalized comparison c on every edge and quotient level. The normalized_inverse calculation identifies the inverse of every normalized comparison with the same canonical scalar-adjunction mate. Hence b=c on each edge, by extensionality of inverse isomorphisms, so both specified rho maps are invertible.

Use the proved exchange_section calculation of the generic scalar rectangle module. Its pull comparison is pullSection; scalarSectionPushMate_eq identifies its push comparison hom with pushSection.hom. Its sectionRectangleExchange is definitionally sectionExchange. The calculation gives ExchangeRealized for both integral and quotient coefficients, including the actual unit, compositor and counit.

Choose the simultaneous normalized section family supplied by normalized_scalar_section_family. Take q, e0 and e to be its actual scalar pair and ordinary/derived comparisons. SectionScalarNormalized supplies exactly the balanced-generator and section K-flat computation clauses of ScalarRealized. Set chi to sectionRectangleLambda for the same endpoint family; lambda_section and rho_section give precisely the two asserted realization equations, with sectionProjection definitionally its specified mate. The chosen chi is uniquely fixed by its realization equation, since the section equivalence is essentially surjective and the other factors are isomorphisms.

For this same simultaneous family, left_route_section and right_route_section identify the images of the two internal routes with their section routes after fixed source and target isomorphisms. Substitute the internal rectangle from the first step and cancel the source isomorphism. This proves the forward section rectangle at every object in the image of the integral section equivalence. Naturality and essential surjectivity extend equality of these natural transformations to all section-derived objects. Postcompose the desired rectangle with direct image of chi_h.hom; cancellation of chi_h.inv followed by chi_h.hom reduces it to the proved forward rectangle. Thus the last factor is exactly direct image of inverse chi_h, without any invertibility assumption on exchange or any completeness or properness restriction. The proved abstract route_natTrans_ext_inv helper performs this essential-surjectivity extension and inverse-edge cancellation before specializing to the section-derived functors.
